layer_1_narrative_constitution.purpose: Defines the immutable storytelling, historical accuracy, and viewer-retention laws that govern every script and shotlist before visual timing is locked.

hard_constraints: First spoken line <= 12 words, containing at least 1 concrete historical noun/year/place (`SC-01`).
Zero greeting, throat-clearing, or channel meta-intro (`BP-73`).
At least 2 visual cuts inside 0–12s must be direct teaser slices from `S13` Climax (`BP-111`).

curiosity_loop_and_re_engagement_laws.rule: Maintain at least 1 active unresolved causal question ('How will Side A survive Constraint X?') across every segment boundary from `S01` through `S13` (`BP-75`). Every loop planted in Acts I–III must be explicitly resolved by `S14` (`600–660s`).
re_engagement_mechanisms: New physical constraint or terrain/weather reveal
Played character micro-scene (`2–6 lines` of in-world dialogue, `BP-108`)
Interruptive pattern shift (1.0–1.5s silence drop before an acoustic/visual impact)

historical_grounding_and_claim_registry_.rule: Every historical date, troop count, weapon range, economic figure, or doctrinal fact in the script must reference a verified `claim_id` in `claims.json` (`BP-68`, `SC-05`). Counterfactual episodes ('What If X fought Y') must ground both belligerents' real historical capabilities, logistics, and commanders in verified historical records before projecting the clash (`BP-155`).

prohibited_elements: No modern idioms, internet slang, or game-show phrasing ('smash subscribe', 'last one to leave wins', 'challenge') in narration or dialogue (`SC-08`).
No camera/production meta-talk ('look at this animation', 'in this video we will show') after `0:15` (`BP-88`).
No anachronistic props, uniforms, architecture, or weapons inside historical scene plates (`BP-87`).
No unmotivated moralizing or modern textbook lecturing in the climax (`SC-12`).

narrator_vo_rules.acoustic_treatment: Dry, intimate, consistent studio vocal chain across the entire 12-minute episode (`ED-01`). NEVER apply room-size or shot-size EQ filters to the narrator!

diegetic_character_dialogue_rules.role: Played in-world character scenes (`14–28%` of timeline dominant audio; e.g., `examples/napoleon_vs_genghis/script.md` Segment 4 `1:15–2:45`).

layer_2_production_profile.purpose: Translates the Narrative Constitution into measurable audio-visual, pacing, motion, color, and GPU-budget controls, explicitly classifying every parameter into Hard Invariants, Adaptive Targets, Diagnostic Metrics, Reference-Only, or Human Review.

parameter_taxonomy_definitions.hard_invariant: Strict physical, mathematical, or pipeline contract. Violation triggers `FAIL` and blocks assembly/render.
parameter_taxonomy_definitions.adaptive_target: Controlled range chosen by Episode Profile (`A..D`) or segment emotional role. Out-of-band triggers `auto_replan` or `WARN`.
parameter_taxonomy_definitions.diagnostic_metric: Statistical rhythm indicator (`BP-83` hypothesis metrics). Out-of-band triggers `REVIEW` flag for editor/director inspection, never a blind hard crash.
parameter_taxonomy_definitions.reference_only: Concrete worked baseline value in the 254-shot reference grid; Claude replaces with episode-specific content.
parameter_taxonomy_definitions.human_review: Creative/editorial quality check requiring human director sign-off at `GATE-1`, `GATE-2`, or `GATE-4`.

still_motion_ladder.rule: Replaces the v1 requirement that every STILL shot must be a literal Photoshop/Blender cutout relocation. Still shots are now governed by a 3-tier duration ladder aligned with user constraints (`<=5s` only with dramatic change) and repository flags (`parallax_25d`, `qwen_nextpose`, `empty_bg_plate`, `BP-84`, `BP-125`).

allowed_techniques: `parallax_25d`: 3-layer depth-separated foreground/midground/background plate with 8–12% camera push/pan + subtle character eye-blink or breathing cycle (`BP-125`).
tiers.prohibited: Flat static 2D image with linear Ken Burns zoom (`BP-84` FAIL).

allowed_techniques: `qwen_nextpose` 2-state character pose/expression transition (e.g., calm posture -> weapon drawn / shocked reaction) over `parallax_25d`.
`lighting_or_plate_state_flip`: dramatic lighting/weather/damage transition across the scene plate at the midpoint of the hold.
tiers.prohibited: Holding a single unchanged character pose > 2.2s without a secondary state flip.

allowed_techniques: `cutout_relocation_with_empty_plate`: foreground character or key artifact is cut out from the source layer (`empty_bg_plate` fills the background gap so no duplicate silhouette remains!) and relocated into a contrasting environment or tactical frame (`BP-84`).
`multi_layer_composite_reveal`: 3-stage sequential visual transformation synchronized to three spoken beats.
tiers.prohibited: Any hold > 3.5s without a full spatial relocation or multi-stage visual transformation (`FAIL`).

relative_color_script_and_continuity.replaces_v1_rule: Replaces absolute global Kelvin/Saturation locks (`5800K -> 2900K`) that overrode scene time-of-day (torchlit tent vs snowy noon battlefield) and violated `BP-166 / LT-62`.
invariant_anchors: Character skin tone, hair, and primary uniform hex codes remain locked across the entire episode via `character_sheet_ref` (`BP-166`).
Each Master Room (`MR01..MR10`) defines its own diegetic base lighting (`base_kelvin`, `base_sat_pct`, `base_val_pct`).

eq_and_spatialization_separation.narrator_vo_chain: Locked studio chain (`ED-01`): high-pass @ 85Hz, gentle presence lift +1.5dB @ 3.2kHz, broadcast compression, target -14 LUFS. NEVER altered by visual shot size (`Wide/Medium/ECU`).
eq_and_spatialization_separation.diegetic_dialogue_and_foley_chain: Driven by visual `shot_size` (`BP-122`): `Wide` (-3dB @ 3.5kHz, 18% room reverb), `Medium` (flat, 8% early reflections), `Close/ECU` (+2dB @ 200Hz & 4kHz, dry intimate proximity).
eq_and_spatialization_separation.sidechain_ducking: Music bed ducks `-9 dB` to `-11 dB` (attack `35ms`, release `280ms`) under both Narrator VO and Character Dialogue (`BP-118`).

master_room_reuse_budget.rule: Although the 12-minute narrative is divided into 16 narrative segments (`S01..S16`), visual environments reuse `10` Master Rooms (`MR01..MR10`) across the episode (`BP-111`), cutting environment art generation by 37.5% while maintaining visual variety via camera angle changes and `HELPER` cutaways.

bounded_timeline_engine_and_jitter_proto.replaces_v1_rule: Replaces the naive `±12%` uniform jitter table (which mathematically failed to reach `CV >= 0.22` in 13 of 16 segments on the v1 baseline and ignored LTX `8k+1` + handle quantization).

why_v1_failed_mathematical_proof_summary.v1_uniform_baseline_problem: In v1, 13 of 16 segments (`S02..S05, S07..S14, S16`) had baseline shot durations so uniform that even at the extreme boundary vertex of the `[-0.12, +0.12]^n` hypercube, their theoretical maximum CV was `< 0.20` (`0.1207` to `0.1960`). Only 3 segments (`S01: 0.2284, S06: 0.2365, S15: 0.2228`) could theoretically exceed `0.22` at an extreme vertex, and under `N=20,000` random draws `0/16` segments reached `0.22`.
why_v1_failed_mathematical_proof_summary.v2_structural_solution: 1) The v2 reference baseline itself is rhythmically diversified (`baseline_shot_cv` between `0.24` and `0.38` in every segment, `max_similar_run <= 2`). 2) The engine applies speech-clause + `1/f` timing offsets (`±18%` band) followed by constrained slack-weighted projection onto the exact segment frame total (`720` or `1440` timeline frames) and derives LTX `8k+1` + `>=4` handle frames (`BP-139`, `BP-128`) from the quantized timeline cut.

deterministic_6_step_algorithm: Step 1 (Speech-Clause & Beat Proposal): Given `random_seed` and TTS clause timestamps (`UR-12` pause-at-cut alignment), propose raw duration `d_i_raw = d_i_base * (1 + 0.35 * pink_drift_seg + 0.65 * clause_offset_i)` with offset in `[-0.18, +0.18]`.
Step 2 (Hard Lane Clamping): Clamp each shot's proposed timeline frames `f_i = round(24 * d_i_raw)` to its lane bounds (`VIDEO: [30, 156]f`, `STILL: [30, 108]f`, `HELPER: [30, 120]f`).

Step 3 (Feasibility & Corner-Case Check): Verify `sum(lo_i) <= F_seg <= sum(hi_i)`. If violated (e.g., too few shots to span `F_seg` under upper bounds), trigger `AUTO_REPLAN_INSERT_OR_MERGE_SHOT` before projection.

Step 4 (Exact Zero-Sum Frame Projection): Distribute `diff = F_seg - sum(f_i)` in single-frame increments across shots with available slack `(f_i < hi_i` if `diff > 0`, `f_i > lo_i` if `diff < 0)` so `sum(f_i) == F_seg` (`720` or `1440` frames) with zero drift.

Step 5 (Local Rhythm Repair / Auto-Replan): Evaluate diagnostic metrics `CV(f) >= 0.20` (`BP-83`) and `max_similar_run(|d_i - d_{i-1}| <= 0.15s) <= 3`. If a local flat run occurs, transfer `4–6` frames (`0.17–0.25s`) between adjacent compatible shots within `[lo_i, hi_i]`.

Step 6 (LTX-2.5 `8k+1` + Handle Compilation): For every `VIDEO` shot with timeline cut `span = f_i`, compute `ltx_generation_frame_count = 8 * ceil((span + 8 - 1) / 8) + 1` so the generated LTX clip satisfies both `BP-139` (`8k+1`) and `BP-128` (`head_handle >= 4`, `tail_handle >= 4`). Set `ltx_generation_spec = null` on `STILL` and `HELPER` shots.
